desc_zh: 一个人从技术选型、部署到生产化，把公司内网自建的 Dify 项目彻底摸透的系列笔记。
desc_en: One engineer's running notes on taking a self-hosted Dify project from tool selection to production.
audience_zh: 适合第一次接触 Dify，或已经做出 Demo、准备走向真实项目的人。
audience_en: For first-time Dify builders and teams moving a working demo toward production.
path_zh: 选型 → Chatflow → 分支与变量 → API → RAG → 批处理 → Agent → 生产化 → 私有部署
path_en: Landscape → Chatflow → Branches and variables → APIs → RAG → Batch processing → Agents → Production → Self-hosting
takeaways_zh: 看懂 Dify 在 AI 应用工具版图里的位置
从零搭出并发布第一个 Chatflow
分清规则分支和模型判断的边界
用变量让应用拥有稳定的数据流和记忆
安全调用外部 API，并补齐异常路径
从清洗、分段到召回测试做一次 RAG
正确使用 Iteration、Loop 与批量处理
让 Agent 在边界内选择和调用工具
用版本、日志、权限和回滚跨过 Demo
用 Docker Compose 接管部署、数据与恢复
takeaways_en: Place Dify correctly on the AI application landscape
Build and publish a first Chatflow from scratch
Separate deterministic branches from model judgement
Use variables for dependable data flow and memory
Call external APIs safely and handle failure paths
Build a RAG flow from cleaning to retrieval tests
Use Iteration, Loop, and batch processing correctly
Let agents choose tools inside explicit boundaries
Cross the demo gap with versions, logs, access, and rollback
Own deployment, data, upgrades, and recovery with Docker Compose
